scenes.narration: Owala, Stanley or YETI? Ask where it will ride: bag, car or trail.
scenes.visual: b-roll:three bottles on a kitchen counter

scenes.narration: In a bag, it has to seal. Owala calls the FreeSip lid leak-proof, and it stays cold for 24 hours.
In a car? The Stanley Quencher. REI says the 40 ounce fits most cup holders, with a handle.
But it resists splashes. It is not leakproof. Do not trust it on its side in a tote.
scenes.visual: product:Stanley Quencher lying on its side in a tote bag

scenes.narration: On the trail? The YETI Rambler with Chug Cap. REI lists it as 100 percent leakproof.
scenes.visual: product:YETI Rambler 26 oz with Chug Cap

scenes.narration: And tell an Owala owner: hand-wash the cup. The lid can go on the top rack.
The full comparison is at the link.
